$riderId..write: auth != null && auth.token.role === 'rider' && auth.token.rider_id === $riderId && auth.token.valid_until > now

driver_location..validate: newData.child('lat').isNumber() && newData.child('lat').val() >= -90 && newData.child('lat').val() <= 90 && newData.child('lng').isNumber() && newData.child('lng').val() >= -180 && newData.child('lng').val() <= 180
